priceChange.subject: Your Hournook price changes on {date}
priceChange.preheader: Your current price stays until {date}. You can cancel any time before then.
priceChange.heading: Your monthly price is changing
priceChange.intro: We’re changing the price of the Hournook plan. For {business}, it goes from {oldPrice} to {newPrice} per month, VAT included.
priceChange.when: Your current price stays until {date}. After that, your subscription renews at the new price.
priceChange.cancel: There’s nothing you need to do. If you’d rather not continue at the new price, you can cancel your subscription any time before {date} from Billing.
priceChange.footer: You’re receiving this because you own a business with a Hournook subscription.
